I've replied in your thread, Tobias: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted in this channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots. She said Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog, and she closed the incident.

The channel doesn't give a street address or other site details for Southgate, and I couldn't find any Tansley account files. If you need more than the name, ask Priyanka.
